entities.summary: Lice is a district and town of Diyarbakır Province, Turkey. Its area is 982 km2 and population is 24,364 (2022). It is located 90 km from the capital, Diyarbakır, and the current governor of the town is Kerem Yenigün. The town is populated by Kurds.
